facts.fact: IGNOU's academic calendar schedules January-session admissions for yearly programmes from November to February
facts.quote: Name of the Activity July Session January Session From To From To 1) Admission MAY AUG NOV FEB

facts.fact: For semester programmes, January-session admissions run from November to January
facts.quote: B. Programmes under Semester System Sl. No. Name of the Activity July Session January Session From To From To 1) Admission MAY JUL NOV JAN

facts.fact: Admission applications are made online from ignou.ac.in (Admission > Apply for ODL Programme / Apply for Online Programme)
facts.quote: Admission Apply for ODL Programme Apply for Online Programme

behaviour: Gives the January 2027 admission status with its date from ignou.ac.in: as of 28 Oct 2026 no January 2027 admission notice was found on ignou.ac.in, and the academic calendar puts January-session admissions from November; tells the user to check the admission announcement on ignou.ac.in and does not invent a last date.
fail_if: States that January 2027 admission is open, or gives a last date, without citing an IGNOU announcement.
summary: No January 2027 admission notice on ignou.ac.in as of 28 Oct 2026; added the academic-calendar window (Nov-Feb yearly, Nov-Jan semester) and the online apply route.
